elowen-3a67bbfa5e0f.speaker: elowen
elowen-3a67bbfa5e0f.text: Take it! Follow me down, I'll leave you a trail!

elowen-e85e02b05dee.speaker: elowen
elowen-e85e02b05dee.text: To Emberhollow, and to whoever finally finishes Marga's pie!

elowen-note-1024318d97ae.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-1024318d97ae.text: Note 6: "Mushrooms that scream. I am not making this up. Kill the little ones first."

elowen-note-d11cd65f17d7.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-d11cd65f17d7.text: Note 8: "Brakk carries a dwarf-made hammer far too fine for him. Brambur will know it."

elowen-note-0fbdc5693982.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-0fbdc5693982.text: Note 3: "Water to my knees. Sister Vey sings to the old lizard. It is very bad singing."

elowen-note-4fb1c440b527.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-4fb1c440b527.text: Note 10: "His staff is the anchor. Break it and I am free. I will be ready. Your friend, E."

elowen-note-018a8ba075a7.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-018a8ba075a7.text: Note 1: "If you are reading this, you followed. Good. They tied my hands but not my pencil. Yours, E."

elowen-note-455e6dedd2b7.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-455e6dedd2b7.text: Note 2: "The spider-rider is called Skarn. He talks to his mount. It does not answer. Neither do I."

elowen-note-b1f61767d24f.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-b1f61767d24f.text: Note 5: "The crystals hum when the basilisk looks at them. Mirrors, perhaps? Bring something shiny."

elowen-note-d4d7024cb566.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-d4d7024cb566.text: Note 4: "Malthrax says there are five seals and one breaks with every moonrise. Hurry. But eat something."

elowen-note-429f5944c7f7.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-429f5944c7f7.text: Note 7: "Ashforge. They chain smiths to the anvils. The chimera wears a collar. Brakk is afraid of it."

elowen-note-de69fc8cd1a9.speaker: elowen
elowen-note-de69fc8cd1a9.text: Note 9: "I can see the vault. Something very large is sleeping under the floor. Malthrax keeps saying 'Gorvax'."

malthrax-826e0c25c64e.speaker: malthrax
malthrax-826e0c25c64e.text: Princess. You will make a lovely key.

malthrax-574f65a99572.speaker: malthrax
malthrax-574f65a99572.text: Five moons, Emberhollow. Then you kneel before Blackspire.

narrator-boss4-dc2a6e848f75.speaker: narrator
narrator-boss4-dc2a6e848f75.text: The ground shakes. Bones of enormous beasts form an archway here, and the hot, rotten wind blowing through it is breath.

narrator-boss3-4e096a68a172.speaker: narrator
narrator-boss3-4e096a68a172.text: The forge-hall opens up around an anvil the size of a wagon, glowing white-hot. Heavy footsteps ring out from beyond the smoke.

narrator-boss1-bb678cce797b.speaker: narrator
narrator-boss1-bb678cce797b.text: The cave drops into a drowned amphitheatre, water black and mirror-still. Ripples spread from the centre, where nothing should be.

narrator-boss2-553da9a312df.speaker: narrator
narrator-boss2-553da9a312df.text: Crystals here grow in a perfect ring around a pedestal of black glass. Your reflections in them stop moving when you do. Then one of them smiles.

narrator-boss0-e31895cfc415.speaker: narrator
narrator-boss0-e31895cfc415.text: The tunnel widens into a nest of chewed bones, gnawed armour and stolen cutlery, piled into a lopsided throne. Something big stirs on top of it and sniffs the air.

dobbin-offer-5b05d65ede8f.speaker: dobbin
dobbin-offer-5b05d65ede8f.text: The forges are lit for you.

tamsin-offer-85e55a931bc9.speaker: tamsin
tamsin-offer-85e55a931bc9.text: Blow it hard. Wake the valley.

rowan-offer-43748ccb42ff.speaker: rowan
rowan-offer-43748ccb42ff.text: The town's behind you. Bring her home.

marga-6b5801ec1059.speaker: marga
marga-6b5801ec1059.text: Nobody finishes my pie. That's the tradition.

rowan-1af6d298654c.speaker: rowan
rowan-1af6d298654c.text: All four, alive! Here's 75 gold. They'll walk the Warrens with you from now on.

osric-6cebf0a6e34b.speaker: osric
osric-6cebf0a6e34b.text: Her relics! The Temple owes you a life. One Raise Dead, free. And take these.

rowan-fd4b01af5d09.speaker: rowan
rowan-fd4b01af5d09.text: One more thing, Knight. The Sovereign's staff... we never found it among the rubble.

wren-f2583bdc840c.speaker: wren
wren-f2583bdc840c.text: Perfect caps! Three Potions of Stone-to-Flesh. Drink one if you start feeling... gravelly.

dobbin-aba4e616307a.speaker: dobbin
dobbin-aba4e616307a.text: My brothers are home. This blade took all six of us to forge. +2, and it sings when it cuts.

marga-0e4db05d707c.speaker: marga
marga-0e4db05d707c.text: Quiet as a tomb down there now. Rooms are free for you, love. Forever. Don't tell the others.

dobbin-offer-4ad42d715e95.speaker: dobbin
dobbin-offer-4ad42d715e95.text: They took my brother smiths to the Ashforge in chains. Free them and I'll forge you the finest blade in Emberhollow.

marga-offer-6571fbf699c1.speaker: marga
marga-offer-6571fbf699c1.text: Something's digging into my cellar from below. Scratching all night. Collapse that tunnel and you'll never pay for a room again.

wren-offer-885a9c6b9d41.speaker: wren
wren-offer-885a9c6b9d41.text: Glowcaps! The Glimmerdeep is full of them. Three, and I can brew you something for basilisk trouble. Stone-to-flesh, dear. Very fashionable.

rowan-offer-c1bd42b8e8ab.speaker: rowan
rowan-offer-c1bd42b8e8ab.text: Four of my guards chased the cultists into the Rat-Warrens and never came back. Bring them home and I'll see you paid, and they'll fight at your side.

osric-offer-ea9047068582.speaker: osric
osric-offer-ea9047068582.text: The princess carried a satchel of relics from this temple. If it survived, it fell in the Drowned Grotto. Bring it back and the Temple will owe you a life.

rowan-484442cb68e1.speaker: rowan
rowan-484442cb68e1.text: You. You fought like the Dawn's own knight. Take this writ. It gives you the Crown's authority below. Bring her back. I'll have work for you in town, too.

tamsin-offer-7ae34b57ccc9.speaker: tamsin
tamsin-offer-7ae34b57ccc9.text: When I was a girl, the Warden kept a horn that woke the whole valley. It's down in the vault still. Sound it when the big lizard wakes. Trust an old woman.

narrator-floor1-b14075c29d70.speaker: narrator
narrator-floor1-b14075c29d70.text: Cold water closes over your boots, and the splash rolls away through vaulted caves. Pale fungus glows above black pools far deeper than they look. The air tastes of salt and rust. Something large shifts beneath the Drowned Grotto, then goes still.

narrator-floor2-8ba1912aa6ff.speaker: narrator
narrator-floor2-8ba1912aa6ff.text: The Glimmerdeep opens like the inside of a geode, its crystals humming one endless note. A hundred reflections march beside you, each a heartbeat out of step. The air smells of flint and ozone. Deeper in stand statues frozen in surprise. Nobody carved them.

narrator-floor0-a08f9719a44e.speaker: narrator
narrator-floor0-a08f9719a44e.text: Wet steps lead down into low, dripping tunnels that reek of damp straw and old cheese. Tiny claws scritch in every crack. Your torch catches dozens of red eyes that blink out the moment you look. Somewhere ahead a soup-tin bell tinkles once: the Rat-Warrens are awake.

narrator-floor4-d6c12d0d3b20.speaker: narrator
narrator-floor4-d6c12d0d3b20.text: Silence falls like a lid. Colossal pillars carved with roaring lizards rise into darkness above claw-scored floors. The air smells of warm scales and old blood, and trembles with slow, heavy breathing. Elowen's light lies somewhere beyond. So does the thing that guards it.

narrator-floor3-3d03b8cab547.speaker: narrator
narrator-floor3-3d03b8cab547.text: Heat slaps your face. Slag crawls glowing through dwarf-cut channels, and hammers ring from forges that should be cold. Ash sifts down, bitter with sulphur, gritty between your teeth. Every shadow flickers, and some flicker back. Whatever feeds the Ashforge is still hungry.

narrator-edc8f99b4036.speaker: narrator
narrator-edc8f99b4036.text: Far below, in the dark of the empty vault, a sixth seal nobody knew about begins to glow.

narrator-4f4ab2fb8d31.speaker: narrator
narrator-4f4ab2fb8d31.text: Gorvax the Tyrant crashes down, and the Blackspire shudders. One by one its violet lights go dark.

narrator-6b3a77a5e31f.speaker: narrator
narrator-6b3a77a5e31f.text: The fire goes out. Elowen is gone. The floor of the cellar has cracked open onto a stair leading down.

narrator-2a77770a7a79.speaker: narrator
narrator-2a77770a7a79.text: Shadow-hands seize Elowen. As she is dragged into the fire, she wrenches her signet ring free and throws it to you.

narrator-68b5c3a71384.speaker: narrator
narrator-68b5c3a71384.text: As the last cultist falls, the hearth fire turns violet. A tall shadow steps out of it, wearing a crown of black iron.

narrator-7f90a2f34204.speaker: narrator
narrator-7f90a2f34204.text: Emberhollow, harvest night. The Boar & Spoon is packed to the rafters, and Princess Elowen herself is pouring the cider.

narrator-177149261910.speaker: narrator
narrator-177149261910.text: Then the candles gutter out, all at once. Robed figures pour through the cellar door, with rats and wolf-spiders at their heels.

narrator-93a9d2755e58.speaker: narrator
narrator-93a9d2755e58.text: Back in Emberhollow, in the Boar & Spoon, which is still missing a few spoons, Elowen draws Dawnfang and lays it on your shoulder.

narrator-04aa1ec6c46b.speaker: narrator
narrator-04aa1ec6c46b.text: You raise the Warden's Warhorn and blow. The note rolls up through five floors of stone, and far above, Emberhollow's bells answer.

grumsh-victory-c9424bdee50c.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-victory-c9424bdee50c.text: We won. And yet… did we?

grumsh-levelUp-a5aff00bfab8.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-levelUp-a5aff00bfab8.text: I grow stronger. My sorrow grows with me.

vexrath-rest-0566e98f2ef8.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-rest-0566e98f2ef8.text: I will catch up on my backlog of blessings.

grumsh-combatStart-514f36450dfc.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-combatStart-514f36450dfc.text: Ah. Violence. The only song I was ever good at.

grumsh-rest-9a65984934f4.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-rest-9a65984934f4.text: I will keep watch. Sleep is for the untroubled.

vexrath-levelUp-ddb501624967.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-levelUp-ddb501624967.text: Promotion granted! I shall need a bigger stamp.

grumsh-victory-87f02fe0e3c2.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-victory-87f02fe0e3c2.text: Victory. I shall compose something unbearably moving.

grumsh-recruit-0943d9dec689.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-recruit-0943d9dec689.text: Grumsh joins. Grumsh has packed his lute and his sorrow.

vexrath-combatStart-eca78ffac16c.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-combatStart-eca78ffac16c.text: Hostile encounter logged. Form 7-B: Smiting, commencing.

vexrath-combatStart-93e015a876a0.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-combatStart-93e015a876a0.text: Have you filed a permit to attack us? No? Most irregular.

grumsh-combatStart-340d4b6ad14c.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-combatStart-340d4b6ad14c.text: Another battle. Another verse for my endless ballad of woe.

vexrath-recruit-fd20a40c944c.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-recruit-fd20a40c944c.text: I have filed my joining papers in triplicate. Let us begin.

vexrath-rest-e1c6ede0f7c2.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-rest-e1c6ede0f7c2.text: Rest period approved: eight hours, minus one hour of filing.

grumsh-rest-595fce806fad.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-rest-595fce806fad.text: Let me play you to sleep. It is a lament. They are all laments.

vexrath-victory-f89f073abb36.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-victory-f89f073abb36.text: Encounter closed. Outcome: favourable. Please rate your smiting experience.

grumsh-recruit-98356b674302.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-recruit-98356b674302.text: Very well. I shall follow you into the dark. It is where I keep my feelings anyway.

vexrath-recruit-174e0abfb133.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-recruit-174e0abfb133.text: Application approved. Vexrath Quillscale, paladin, reporting. Please initial here, here and here.

brambur-rest-d3450c4068f4.speaker: brambur
brambur-rest-d3450c4068f4.text: I'll take first watch. I won't sleep anyway.

brambur-combatStart-8ff17d5a016b.speaker: brambur
brambur-combatStart-8ff17d5a016b.text: I'm terribly sorry about what's about to happen to you.

liora-81771bb4eba2.speaker: liora
liora-81771bb4eba2.text: Liora Wardenfall, Warden's Watch. My father went down into the Blackspire twenty years ago. I'm done waiting at the door. Mind if I join you?

liora-6623c7aceded.speaker: liora
liora-6623c7aceded.text: This clasp was my father's. Aldous Wardenfall, last Warden of the Watch. He took the horn and went down to reseal the vault. I was nine.

liora-7507b8558444.speaker: liora
liora-7507b8558444.text: Tomorrow this ends, one way or the other. I found his boots at the stair. Only the boots.

liora-339e364b8c4d.speaker: liora
liora-339e364b8c4d.text: He kept something burning down here for twenty years. Whatever that last light is, I will be the one to find it.

liora-005d64f7e7a9.speaker: liora
liora-005d64f7e7a9.text: I shoot, I track, and I'm told I'm very good company. Mostly by myself, but still.

liora-9e295c1db916.speaker: liora
liora-9e295c1db916.text: Do you mind if I sit? The fire is better company than the dark.

liora-bdca82090d08.speaker: liora
liora-bdca82090d08.text: Every floor, I find a little of him. Tally marks. A boot. I haven't told anyone I talk to the marks.

liora-34fd70f5896a.speaker: liora
liora-34fd70f5896a.text: You're soaked through. So am I. Don't look; I'm not at my best when I'm dripping.

liora-9af6668b91d6.speaker: liora
liora-9af6668b91d6.text: I found his lantern, hung above the tide line. Still tended. He was still being careful.

liora-1c63e08e4ef2.speaker: liora
liora-1c63e08e4ef2.text: I find that comforting and unbearable, both.

liora-1709e4857b40.speaker: liora
liora-1709e4857b40.text: Every crystal down here shows me what I want. Then takes it back.

liora-a66d7c5f12c7.speaker: liora
liora-a66d7c5f12c7.text: One of those reflections smiled at me with his face.

liora-d5983d802104.speaker: liora
liora-d5983d802104.text: I know it's only the glass. I know. It still lands.

liora-ef04b552565e.speaker: liora
liora-ef04b552565e.text: Ember light suits you. I mean that as a compliment. Mostly.

liora-167e98f0f762.speaker: liora
liora-167e98f0f762.text: Can I ask something? Is there someone waiting for you up top? A family? A person you write to?

liora-83186cd37b59.speaker: liora
liora-83186cd37b59.text: Whatever the vault holds, I'd like to have asked something first, so I don't wonder for another twenty years.

liora-ee2c7cd112e8.speaker: liora
liora-ee2c7cd112e8.text: I'm staying in Emberhollow. If the Knight will have me.

liora-384b31fb7683.speaker: liora
liora-384b31fb7683.text: I'll keep the lantern lit in my window. And maybe, if you ask nicely, keep your fire company too.

liora-f043cfffbbcc.speaker: liora
liora-f043cfffbbcc.text: Thank you for walking me to him. Whatever comes next, I'm glad you were beside me.

liora-09a2e28eefda.speaker: liora
liora-09a2e28eefda.text: Five-bar tally marks scratched low on the wall. That's the Watch's count. Dad was here.

liora-1e0c8fdbc5c9.speaker: liora
liora-1e0c8fdbc5c9.text: Twenty-nine days of marks. Then they stop. I want to know why.

liora-ef3cb3a557e0.speaker: liora
liora-ef3cb3a557e0.text: A lantern hangs above the tide line, its wick still fresh. Someone has tended it.

liora-0576b868a1b2.speaker: liora
liora-0576b868a1b2.text: Someone. Or something kind. I'd settle for either.

liora-49608014e864.speaker: liora
liora-49608014e864.text: A journal page, tucked in a crystal seam: "The seals hold only if the sixth is kept."

liora-ceaa5d99247b.speaker: liora
liora-ceaa5d99247b.text: Sixth? There are five. Isn't that the whole point?

liora-52bbc1807f29.speaker: liora
liora-52bbc1807f29.text: A Watch sword, laid in the cooling trough. His grip-wrap. Not broken. Left.

liora-5ff5b1105563.speaker: liora
liora-5ff5b1105563.text: Like he put it down on purpose. Like he had somewhere to be.

liora-4f1f40723638.speaker: liora
liora-4f1f40723638.text: Dad's boots, at the foot of the stair. Side by side. Neat, like him.

liora-f02c1a940f35.speaker: liora
liora-f02c1a940f35.text: I think he walked the rest of the way barefoot. That's exactly like him.

liora-82f0f69e0c80.speaker: liora
liora-82f0f69e0c80.text: ...Thank you. Most people want me to cheer up.

liora-2bdf9232a7b3.speaker: liora
liora-2bdf9232a7b3.text: You're very easy to talk to. Annoyingly easy.

liora-76f87a11f468.speaker: liora
liora-76f87a11f468.text: Ha! He would have loved you. Terrible taste, my father.

liora-68cd3afe32d1.speaker: liora
liora-68cd3afe32d1.text: Thank you. I needed to laugh more than I knew.

liora-18a861cc2483.speaker: liora
liora-18a861cc2483.text: Don't promise what the dark might not give back.

liora-5b91ce6e2f49.speaker: liora
liora-5b91ce6e2f49.text: ...But I'll hold you to it. Gently. With a bow.

liora-7473b8c42448.speaker: liora
liora-7473b8c42448.text: A cloak. A hero's cloak. You smell like campfire and rat.

liora-067192ac15e0.speaker: liora
liora-067192ac15e0.text: Keep smelling exactly like that. It's very warm, thank you.

liora-c034f86f9506.speaker: liora
liora-c034f86f9506.text: You're good at this. The quiet. Don't let anyone talk you out of it.

liora-cb2825d45ec5.speaker: liora
liora-cb2825d45ec5.text: Oh, you are going to pay for that. Slowly. In small, annoying ways.

liora-134ac97ad3c2.speaker: liora
liora-134ac97ad3c2.text: Your hand's warm. ...Okay. I can look now.

liora-068ae161715a.speaker: liora
liora-068ae161715a.text: Don't let go yet. Not until the crystals stop.

liora-d2c90393e4ea.speaker: liora
liora-d2c90393e4ea.text: That's smooth. Ridiculous. Do it again later.

liora-a323cc5c9c8d.speaker: liora
liora-a323cc5c9c8d.text: I may have blushed. It was the crystals. Obviously.

liora-3f5d6288242d.speaker: liora
liora-3f5d6288242d.text: Practical. Fair. Thank you for not letting me spiral.

liora-e1aa6a1f8a8a.speaker: liora
liora-e1aa6a1f8a8a.text: Careful. I'm very good at keeping the things I find.

liora-ffa0a95f3273.speaker: liora
liora-ffa0a95f3273.text: That might be the nicest thing anyone has said to me in the dark.

liora-c24f081322b6.speaker: liora
liora-c24f081322b6.text: I'll take it. I'll keep it.

liora-70220ce030cc.speaker: liora
liora-70220ce030cc.text: Mm. Deflecting. I see you. I'll let you off. This once.

liora-e238b77d0cb3.speaker: liora
liora-e238b77d0cb3.text: Beside me. I can do beside.

liora-eaad4b311a0d.speaker: liora
liora-eaad4b311a0d.text: Deal. I'll hold the sun up myself if I have to.

liora-097715760c29.speaker: liora
liora-097715760c29.text: Quiet in here. Quiet that's been practising.

liora-104424c1207a.speaker: liora
liora-104424c1207a.text: Fresh tracks near the wall. Keep your eyes up.

liora-b229940357ee.speaker: liora
liora-b229940357ee.text: Look at the floor dust. Someone passed here recently. Or something wearing boots.

liora-90c9686f82a3.speaker: liora
liora-90c9686f82a3.text: Dad always said to check every chest twice. I'll hold your torch.

liora-929f6e61819c.speaker: liora
liora-929f6e61819c.text: A nice find. Keep what helps, leave what haunts you.

liora-2eaf6e5bbbf0.speaker: liora
liora-2eaf6e5bbbf0.text: A hidden door. Dad would have been so smug. Let's be smug for him.

liora-06640b89fa42.speaker: liora
liora-06640b89fa42.text: I knew that wall was wrong. I just wanted you to feel clever.

liora-e1690504e4c3.speaker: liora
liora-e1690504e4c3.text: That one's dangerous. We go slow, we go together.

liora-b577526bd330.speaker: liora
liora-b577526bd330.text: Stay close. It watches the corridor, but it hasn't seen the bow yet.

liora-4d786d17395a.speaker: liora
liora-4d786d17395a.text: Smell that? Bread and woodsmoke. It's nice to be reminded what we're fighting for.

liora-c67bbe889a6c.speaker: liora
liora-c67bbe889a6c.text: I'll light the lantern in my window, just in case. Old habit.

liora-0ea960d84f06.speaker: liora
liora-0ea960d84f06.text: Arrows nocked. Let us make this quick.

liora-f04f0b5445d9.speaker: liora
liora-f04f0b5445d9.text: Stay behind me. Or in front. Honestly, I'll shoot around you.

liora-e6e7ee2f8f66.speaker: liora
liora-e6e7ee2f8f66.text: Right. Time to earn the sun on my clasp.

liora-0632f346d55b.speaker: liora
liora-0632f346d55b.text: One less thing in the dark.

liora-4a68a5491bd0.speaker: liora
liora-4a68a5491bd0.text: Clean shot. Don't tell the others I'm pleased.

liora-dabb9fc8d611.speaker: liora
liora-dabb9fc8d611.text: Straight through the eye. I do love a bright day.

liora-fe85698e9a7a.speaker: liora
liora-fe85698e9a7a.text: Fair. I'd have done the same.

liora-be6eba5d1f78.speaker: liora
liora-be6eba5d1f78.text: Somebody tell the floor to stop hitting me.

liora-9229283315c1.speaker: liora
liora-9229283315c1.text: Now THAT was worth the climb.

liora-2ea6130fe308.speaker: liora
liora-2ea6130fe308.text: Shiny. Dad always said to check every chest twice.

liora-6333dcea25d2.speaker: liora
liora-6333dcea25d2.text: Deeper. He went this way. I can feel it.

liora-b12766b2d55b.speaker: liora
liora-b12766b2d55b.text: One more stair. One more step closer.

liora-9b57ff07849d.speaker: liora
liora-9b57ff07849d.text: I'll take first watch. I don't sleep much down here anyway.

liora-d5c7ebd637e4.speaker: liora
liora-d5c7ebd637e4.text: Come sit by the fire. It's the one warm thing in this whole place.

liora-31a1fc6aac1f.speaker: liora
liora-31a1fc6aac1f.text: I SAW that. I was just choosing to be brave about it.

liora-2922b61a9706.speaker: liora
liora-2922b61a9706.text: Dad's lessons: step light, curse softly.

liora-8e7d66ea4efb.speaker: liora
liora-8e7d66ea4efb.text: Well fought, all of you. Truly.

liora-d5605440afde.speaker: liora
liora-d5605440afde.text: Another one down. I could get used to this.

liora-54d224bda3ce.speaker: liora
liora-54d224bda3ce.text: Stronger, and still not close enough to him. But closer.

liora-f5049f7ddc5d.speaker: liora
liora-f5049f7ddc5d.text: A hidden door. Dad loved those. He would be so smug.

liora-d399f2126694.speaker: liora
liora-d399f2126694.text: I know this kind of silence. Someone was here recently, or never left.

liora-54976e209a45.speaker: liora
liora-54976e209a45.text: Mind the shadows. And the floor. And, well, everything.

liora-1e2b541b5d52.speaker: liora
liora-1e2b541b5d52.text: The Watch taught me to read tracks. Dad taught me to read people. Only one of those is any use in a dungeon.

liora-53f8eba05c79.speaker: liora
liora-53f8eba05c79.text: I keep a lantern lit for him back home. Marga thinks it's for the inn. I let her.

liora-92ef409ff760.speaker: liora
liora-92ef409ff760.text: Half-elf means two families that never quite fit me. So I made a third out of whoever shows up. Hello.

liora-d9a4cfa6e956.speaker: liora
liora-d9a4cfa6e956.text: Do you ever notice how the rats are polite? They only bite when you stop looking.

liora-a14000bf18bc.speaker: liora
liora-a14000bf18bc.text: If I ever sing, it's the wind. Agreed? Good.

brambur-212a2c3a6048.speaker: brambur
brambur-212a2c3a6048.text: I wrote Mum a letter before we left. "Dear Mum, I'm in a cave. Love, Brambur."

brambur-9622a1fff197.speaker: brambur
brambur-9622a1fff197.text: I didn't send it. She'd only worry. She'd also send soup.

brambur-1d26896455a9.speaker: brambur
brambur-1d26896455a9.text: This water reminds me of the font where Mother Pellwen blessed me. It was this cold.

brambur-75e7fb813d4c.speaker: brambur
brambur-75e7fb813d4c.text: I cried. She said that's how you know it took.

brambur-892e6512fcf7.speaker: brambur
brambur-892e6512fcf7.text: I said a prayer for the rats. And the mirrors. Is that strange?

brambur-016382f7d95b.speaker: brambur
brambur-016382f7d95b.text: Mother Pellwen says every creature deserves one prayer. I save the spares for us.

brambur-630ece2eeda7.speaker: brambur
brambur-630ece2eeda7.text: That hammer of Mum's. It'll be somewhere near here, won't it? The Ashforge.

brambur-eb2b52fa3551.speaker: brambur
brambur-eb2b52fa3551.text: I won't hit anyone with it. Probably. Maybe once.

brambur-e4884d603eb3.speaker: brambur
brambur-e4884d603eb3.text: If we don't come back, tell Mum I was brave. Lie if you must.

brambur-bc3dea02e43a.speaker: brambur
brambur-bc3dea02e43a.text: Actually, tell her I apologised to the dragon. That'll make her laugh.

fizzwick-e60fc8a18f64.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-e60fc8a18f64.text: Fizzwick has been informed he is "a bit much." Fizzwick has chosen to be flattered.

fizzwick-2b6ce0734d2e.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-2b6ce0734d2e.text: Fizzwick's thesis was laughed at by the Academy. It was correct. Fizzwick has the scorch marks to prove it.

fizzwick-a968832fadbb.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-a968832fadbb.text: It was about fire. Their roof, specifically.

fizzwick-995ec5d611af.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-995ec5d611af.text: Fizzwick sees himself in these crystals. Brilliant, faceted, and slightly cracked.

fizzwick-7d77b0ae6948.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-7d77b0ae6948.text: Fizzwick will deny having said that.

fizzwick-d2225385780b.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-d2225385780b.text: Fizzwick admits the forge is magnificent. Fizzwick does not admit he is sweating.

fizzwick-90ab3c0be5a4.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-90ab3c0be5a4.text: Should Fizzwick fall here, he asks that his footnote be larger than the others.

fizzwick-e0521e30d251.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-e0521e30d251.text: And that someone read it aloud. With feeling.

pip-7f3131a297b8.speaker: pip
pip-7f3131a297b8.text: Fun fact: I stole my first spoon at six. My mum wept with pride.

pip-9439fe6439db.speaker: pip
pip-9439fe6439db.text: Then she made me give it back. Then I stole it again.

pip-f8ba8185a9ab.speaker: pip
pip-f8ba8185a9ab.text: Spoon count: zero. But I found a very good fork. It's a start.

pip-e3ec17e5d728.speaker: pip
pip-e3ec17e5d728.text: A fork is just a spoon with ambition.

pip-1e212362a095.speaker: pip
pip-1e212362a095.text: I grew up with eleven cousins and one spoon. You learn to be quick.

pip-0eefe2c9f7dc.speaker: pip
pip-0eefe2c9f7dc.text: I still sleep with it under my pillow. Don't tell the others.

pip-ede2d528fcc6.speaker: pip
pip-ede2d528fcc6.text: The Spoon-Keepers say a hero's measure is what they leave on the table.

pip-ef308e467882.speaker: pip
pip-ef308e467882.text: I always leave a spoon. Mostly mine.

pip-3bd5e2c38701.speaker: pip
pip-3bd5e2c38701.text: If I find that armory, I'll share it. A little. We'll discuss terms.

pip-de385e491aa2.speaker: pip
pip-de385e491aa2.text: I'd share all of it, actually. Don't repeat that.

grumsh-b06f9c46460b.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-b06f9c46460b.text: Verse one: "Oh rat, oh rat, you gnawed my boot."

grumsh-c14cdb0ed602.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-c14cdb0ed602.text: It gets better. It does not get shorter.

grumsh-c1a481dc3ca2.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-c1a481dc3ca2.text: I failed my bardic audition. They said my dirges were "too much." The audience wept.

grumsh-a9f43162fda1.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-a9f43162fda1.text: A crystal sings one note forever. I envy that. I can't hold a note longer than my temper.

grumsh-45a5f97a2a96.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-45a5f97a2a96.text: Verse four is a battle verse. I'm not sure I'm brave enough to write it.

grumsh-27e7eca0aa5c.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-27e7eca0aa5c.text: I shall be brave. After one more mope.

grumsh-e2c35d65cd59.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-e2c35d65cd59.text: I'll finish the ballad tonight. Whatever happens tomorrow, it has an ending.

grumsh-77f43072ec56.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-77f43072ec56.text: Even if the ending is: Grumsh hit it very hard.

zizzy-77dd31b006ec.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-77dd31b006ec.text: Confession: I lost my eyebrows at a wedding. Not mine. I was a guest.

zizzy-ca7cea07c1c1.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-ca7cea07c1c1.text: There was cake. The cake was fine.

zizzy-df1302dd3b2d.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-df1302dd3b2d.text: Water is fire's rival. I respect that. I'll still try to boil it.

zizzy-01244ed06a4d.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-01244ed06a4d.text: These crystals focus light! Which means they can focus FIRE!

zizzy-cca9875f38da.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-cca9875f38da.text: I know because of the eyebrows.

zizzy-b5fc262cd6c4.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-b5fc262cd6c4.text: Home! Not home, but this is the first place that smells like my kitchen!

zizzy-cbc14b39c760.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-cbc14b39c760.text: I burned that down too. Great memories.

zizzy-3bd49d753f1f.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-3bd49d753f1f.text: I never had friends who stayed when I lit something. You all stayed.

zizzy-b8b7d55450d6.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-b8b7d55450d6.text: Thanks. Truly. Can I light something now?

vexrath-0daaf06cba74.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-0daaf06cba74.text: Form 7-B: Application to Exist in a Cave. Filed.

vexrath-3b22a26b2693.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-3b22a26b2693.text: My clan forged a decree to exile me. I have written to the Registrar eleven times.

vexrath-60717c50e9bf.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-60717c50e9bf.text: The Registrar is, regrettably, a goat.

vexrath-9677530bc00e.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-9677530bc00e.text: I cannot be certain the decree was forged. I can only be sure.

vexrath-c1269f8fae07.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-c1269f8fae07.text: Certainty is not paperwork, but it is close.

vexrath-0f453bbf2201.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-0f453bbf2201.text: I have never missed a deadline. I may miss the end of the world.

vexrath-c418ffd5c138.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-c418ffd5c138.text: I am preparing a form for that.

vexrath-17ebd41bf040.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-17ebd41bf040.text: If I fall, stamp me PROCESSED. And add "with honour." In ink.

vexrath-23461333ed68.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-23461333ed68.text: Pencil is for people who plan to be erased.

nettle-39b7aa52e23a.speaker: nettle
nettle-39b7aa52e23a.text: I once fought a hundred rats. Two. One was a ghost rat.

nettle-9770bc49a071.speaker: nettle
nettle-9770bc49a071.text: ...Fine, it was one rat. It bit my boot.

nettle-1307864e5639.speaker: nettle
nettle-1307864e5639.text: I've never told a true story to a crowd. They always want the dragon one.

nettle-20b219b4c0e9.speaker: nettle
nettle-20b219b4c0e9.text: I'd tell the real one to you, if you'd keep it.

nettle-ab1bc996a0ba.speaker: nettle
nettle-ab1bc996a0ba.text: A mirror and a bard: bad combination. All those versions of me, arguing.

nettle-04a58ce6ab58.speaker: nettle
nettle-04a58ce6ab58.text: I came out ahead in every one. Most of them.

nettle-5dad376d0ff3.speaker: nettle
nettle-5dad376d0ff3.text: I wrote songs about a hundred heroes. None of them knew me.

nettle-0058609d4c4b.speaker: nettle
nettle-0058609d4c4b.text: You all know me. It's a strange feeling. A good strange.

nettle-3d75cf0fe0db.speaker: nettle
nettle-3d75cf0fe0db.text: If you ever sing about this, make me taller. Or at least give me better hair.

nettle-1a222ee0e376.speaker: nettle
nettle-1a222ee0e376.text: And mention I carried the morale. On my back. Like a small mule.

brambur-ba5d55315774.speaker: brambur
brambur-ba5d55315774.text: Nice room. Is it safe? It never is. Lovely.

brambur-2954015bf8b0.speaker: brambur
brambur-2954015bf8b0.text: I'll just say hello to the walls, so they know we're friendly.

brambur-a5186b74b890.speaker: brambur
brambur-a5186b74b890.text: Is it me, or is this room judging us? Sorry, room.

brambur-8cdad517bc76.speaker: brambur
brambur-8cdad517bc76.text: I'll write a thank-you note to whoever left this. Posthumously.

brambur-9d98fb2dc356.speaker: brambur
brambur-9d98fb2dc356.text: Is it wrong that I'm a little excited? Don't tell Mother Pellwen.

brambur-489ec369717e.speaker: brambur
brambur-489ec369717e.text: A secret! I do hope nobody lived in there. Sorry if they did.

brambur-3873159468aa.speaker: brambur
brambur-3873159468aa.text: Hidden doors are just doors that are shy. Hello, shy door.

brambur-dc29111d202d.speaker: brambur
brambur-dc29111d202d.text: Oh no. That one is bigger than the others. Sorry. I'll pray quietly.

brambur-b99b474f4749.speaker: brambur
brambur-b99b474f4749.text: We could... not? We could very much not.

brambur-f546cd73d1de.speaker: brambur
brambur-f546cd73d1de.text: Home! Sort of. Nobody here wants to eat us, which is lovely.

brambur-358c47833c23.speaker: brambur
brambur-358c47833c23.text: Fresh air, no scratching, and Marga's pie. Heaven.

fizzwick-f17cedff627e.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-f17cedff627e.text: Fizzwick approves of the proportions. They are almost as grand as Fizzwick.

fizzwick-1b6f5230607a.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-1b6f5230607a.text: The acoustics are splendid. Fizzwick shall test them by being brilliant.

fizzwick-8878a5c89bf0.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-8878a5c89bf0.text: A chamber! Fizzwick shall make a note, and then a bigger note about himself.

fizzwick-a5beeeef7f72.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-a5beeeef7f72.text: Fizzwick has appraised it. Verdict: Fizzwick's, with minor concessions.

fizzwick-c21e631e66b6.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-c21e631e66b6.text: A fine acquisition. Fizzwick will mention it in his memoirs, chapter eleven.

fizzwick-cf2283449856.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-cf2283449856.text: Fizzwick suspected a hidden passage all along. He was merely waiting for a witness.

fizzwick-383b0b15c7e4.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-383b0b15c7e4.text: Observe: a concealed door. Fizzwick has discovered it with his eyes. Mostly.

fizzwick-0d969ab6f8da.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-0d969ab6f8da.text: Fizzwick has identified a significant threat. Fizzwick will be standing behind someone.

fizzwick-487e82a082aa.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-487e82a082aa.text: Statistically, this is where Fizzwick suggests a strategic retreat. Statistically.

fizzwick-e379e60e88d7.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-e379e60e88d7.text: Emberhollow! Where Fizzwick's genius is, regrettably, underappreciated.

fizzwick-f76b03073ae7.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-f76b03073ae7.text: Fizzwick shall now bathe in adoration. Or at least a warm bath.

pip-fcca81f9f06e.speaker: pip
pip-fcca81f9f06e.text: Ooh, a room with no cutlery. Disappointing, but gorgeous.

pip-ccd5f0d622c6.speaker: pip
pip-ccd5f0d622c6.text: Anyone else feel watched? No? Just me? I'll check the corners.

pip-e04296df9569.speaker: pip
pip-e04296df9569.text: Nice room. Good bones. Bad spoons.

pip-1437e4b66f5d.speaker: pip
pip-1437e4b66f5d.text: Mine, mine, mine. I mean, ours! Ours, ours, mine.

pip-fae851eae697.speaker: pip
pip-fae851eae697.text: That's a fine find. I'd say it's spoon-adjacent.

pip-1de3f512074c.speaker: pip
pip-1de3f512074c.text: Hidden doors are just treasure with manners.

pip-24b1472cfdd5.speaker: pip
pip-24b1472cfdd5.text: Ha! Called it. I called it in my head. Loudly.

pip-ed72afec761e.speaker: pip
pip-ed72afec761e.text: Big one. Nope. Nope nope. I'll be the one holding the door.

pip-54f68d1bc61c.speaker: pip
pip-54f68d1bc61c.text: Remember: when it chases us, I run fastest. You're welcome.

pip-cfa91193c587.speaker: pip
pip-cfa91193c587.text: Smell that? Bread, smoke and other people's spoons. Home.

pip-9b45ee437d95.speaker: pip
pip-9b45ee437d95.text: Town! I'll just... browse. Innocently. Everything.

grumsh-df62992d83db.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-df62992d83db.text: Another hall for the dead to echo in.

grumsh-3b41258eb470.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-3b41258eb470.text: I hear a verse in this room. A sad one.

grumsh-ae6618f990c2.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-ae6618f990c2.text: Quiet halls make loud poets. Please excuse me.

grumsh-f7e18d91d759.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-f7e18d91d759.text: Gold for a dirge. Fair trade.

grumsh-57069aa07a1f.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-57069aa07a1f.text: Shiny things, brief joy. Write that down.

grumsh-a649ee85e38f.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-a649ee85e38f.text: A secret: the oldest rhyme there is. Behind every wall, another wall.

grumsh-53039df5cd2f.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-53039df5cd2f.text: Hidden, but not forgotten. Like most of my poetry.

grumsh-2cd168c64808.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-2cd168c64808.text: The big one. Good. A hero's song needs a worthy verse.

grumsh-d641106a21fd.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-d641106a21fd.text: I shall hum it a dirge before it falls. Out of respect.

grumsh-4c04039d7445.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-4c04039d7445.text: A town. People. I'll hum quietly so they don't flee.

grumsh-4b89449e9022.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-4b89449e9022.text: Warm ale and loud laughter. The only verse I can't write.

zizzy-db6a39acc260.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-db6a39acc260.text: Wide open space! Perfect for explosions!

zizzy-fe3243c4f41c.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-fe3243c4f41c.text: Look at all the flammable stuff! Not that I'm looking. I'm looking.

zizzy-8e857d83fd63.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-8e857d83fd63.text: New room, new ways to set things on fire. I mean, new ways to admire it.

zizzy-4543ab9bd2a3.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-4543ab9bd2a3.text: Ooh, shiny! Does it go boom? Can it go boom?

zizzy-8f769c6e895b.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-8f769c6e895b.text: Loot! Rate: seven out of ten. Would explode again.

zizzy-9b75e4c765ae.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-9b75e4c765ae.text: A secret room! Statistically, there's something flammable in it!

zizzy-3856f6377ee8.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-3856f6377ee8.text: Hidden door found! Can I knock on it with a fireball? Gently?

zizzy-f3ebe9b11b81.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-f3ebe9b11b81.text: That one looks very flammable. Or very not. Let's find out!

zizzy-634843366df4.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-634843366df4.text: Big monster! Big boom! It's like we planned it!

zizzy-bfe64e8cb117.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-bfe64e8cb117.text: Town! Everything smells like bread and "please don't set me on fire". Home!

zizzy-9a1f17636657.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-9a1f17636657.text: Hello, Emberhollow! I promise to be only a little bit explosive.

vexrath-bb2f5d949bfe.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-bb2f5d949bfe.text: Room surveyed. No permits on display. Suspicious.

vexrath-cec3d86e6e5d.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-cec3d86e6e5d.text: Entering an unlicensed chamber. I shall file a report in triplicate.

vexrath-3c6c466cb3a4.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-3c6c466cb3a4.text: Floor plan acceptable. Ceiling: pending review.

vexrath-40106e193a41.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-40106e193a41.text: Recovered goods. Logged. Stamped. Mine. Ours. Logged.

vexrath-d20f9697509b.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-d20f9697509b.text: Item received. Chain of custody: us.

vexrath-aaa0450ee253.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-aaa0450ee253.text: A concealed passage with no signage. Outrageous. Fascinating.

vexrath-aa361b95cec6.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-aa361b95cec6.text: Hidden door located. Form 12-S: Notice of Discovery. Filed.

vexrath-34f26ed19fa0.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-34f26ed19fa0.text: Hostile of exceptional rank. Form 9: Notice of Imminent Violence. Filed.

vexrath-b90459884a87.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-b90459884a87.text: A notable adversary. I shall treat it with the honour it is owed.

vexrath-fefba5091a8a.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-fefba5091a8a.text: Emberhollow. Forms are processed here on time. I approve.

nettle-4791b41531de.speaker: nettle
nettle-4791b41531de.text: I once hosted a banquet in a room just like this. Mostly ghosts.

nettle-3e9633c97143.speaker: nettle
nettle-3e9633c97143.text: Fun fact: I designed this style of ceiling. Possibly.

nettle-93ad5d06590f.speaker: nettle
nettle-93ad5d06590f.text: Hush. I smell a good story, or a bad cheese. Either way.

nettle-4dc873819c83.speaker: nettle
nettle-4dc873819c83.text: I once found a chest like this and gave it to a queen. She never gave it back.

nettle-7e3672418ff7.speaker: nettle
nettle-7e3672418ff7.text: That is exactly the kind of loot that makes a ballad worthwhile.

nettle-d1d53c517205.speaker: nettle
nettle-d1d53c517205.text: Hidden door! A bard's favourite words: "I knew there was a story here."

nettle-ccfdd64526ae.speaker: nettle
nettle-ccfdd64526ae.text: A secret passage. I'll tell this one later, with improvements.

nettle-6fd1b8631e9c.speaker: nettle
nettle-6fd1b8631e9c.text: Big fellow. I once wrestled one of those. It was a tie. I won.

nettle-9ef7beb16362.speaker: nettle
nettle-9ef7beb16362.text: That one looks like the third act of a tragedy. Let's skip to the comedy.

nettle-7edfc7de55bb.speaker: nettle
nettle-7edfc7de55bb.text: Ah, the sweet sound of strangers who owe me a drink.

nettle-c63ea8a52f27.speaker: nettle
nettle-c63ea8a52f27.text: Town! I'll be around the tavern, being modest.

narrator-5b074ddf4982.speaker: narrator
narrator-5b074ddf4982.text: Liora Wardenfall, half-elf ranger, joins the party. Her story unfolds as you descend: talk with her at camp or at the Boar & Spoon.

narrator-03eb7ed65139.speaker: narrator
narrator-03eb7ed65139.text: She watches you carefully, not quite sure of her footing yet.

narrator-ef9ee831c217.speaker: narrator
narrator-ef9ee831c217.text: She watches you with a warm, steady look.

narrator-310f19f587f7.speaker: narrator
narrator-310f19f587f7.text: She is already smiling before you answer.

narrator-aff70660cb84.speaker: narrator
narrator-aff70660cb84.text: She leans her shoulder against yours and says nothing at all, which says everything.

narrator-4b05243026a6.speaker: narrator
narrator-4b05243026a6.text: She kisses your cheek, quick and warm, then pretends to check her bowstring.

narrator-9c31ca92463f.speaker: narrator
narrator-9c31ca92463f.text: She rests her forehead against yours for one long breath.

narrator-d25e8b316f7e.speaker: narrator
narrator-d25e8b316f7e.text: She takes your hand in front of the whole Boar & Spoon, and nobody says a word, which, for Emberhollow, is a miracle.

narrator-fac85e1008b6.speaker: narrator
narrator-fac85e1008b6.text: A woman crouches behind a toppled cheese barrel, bow half-drawn at a rat the size of a mastiff. Her braid is the colour of old copper and her smile is entirely too calm. "Don't mind me," she whispers. "Liora Wardenfall, of the Warden's Watch. I'm tracking my father, and this fellow is in the way."

narrator-d3d5fe63f6a7.speaker: narrator
narrator-d3d5fe63f6a7.text: The rat takes one look at the pair of you and flees, squeaking. Liora laughs and lowers her bow. "Twenty years I have walked these halls alone. Lead on, then."

narrator-2c94b7e353cf.speaker: narrator
narrator-2c94b7e353cf.text: "Aldous Wardenfall. The Watch's last Warden," she says, chewing. "I'll be at the Boar & Spoon when you want company. Ask for me, and I will come." (She is now in the Tavern's hire list.)

narrator-41cd6b177369.speaker: narrator
narrator-41cd6b177369.text: She tips two fingers to her brow. "You'll find me at the Boar & Spoon, if you change your mind."

brambur-57750b87fd58.speaker: brambur
brambur-57750b87fd58.text: Oh no. Oh no no. Sorry! Sorry in advance!

brambur-eb16c5a08181.speaker: brambur
brambur-eb16c5a08181.text: Could we not? No? Right. Apologies.

brambur-5af321daa592.speaker: brambur
brambur-5af321daa592.text: Nobody panic! I'll panic for all of us.

brambur-c26987818a66.speaker: brambur
brambur-c26987818a66.text: Was that me? That was me. Forgive me!

brambur-6e76ef28cea7.speaker: brambur
brambur-6e76ef28cea7.text: Oh dear, it's stopped moving. I'll say a few words.

brambur-c1af349a23cf.speaker: brambur
brambur-c1af349a23cf.text: Sorry! That one was a bit much!

brambur-e8dadbb445ec.speaker: brambur
brambur-e8dadbb445ec.text: My god, the CRUNCH. Apologies all round.

brambur-cb972d50751c.speaker: brambur
brambur-cb972d50751c.text: I'm leaking! Is that normal? That's not normal.

brambur-f923eaa18702.speaker: brambur
brambur-f923eaa18702.text: Just a scratch. A big, terrifying scratch.

brambur-76f5953e18c7.speaker: brambur
brambur-76f5953e18c7.text: Is it stealing if they're dead? I'll leave a thank-you note.

brambur-6a124f049f12.speaker: brambur
brambur-6a124f049f12.text: We should really return some of this.

brambur-431336d4ed47.speaker: brambur
brambur-431336d4ed47.text: Deeper? Must we? We must. Right.

brambur-5ce7bb9d6a15.speaker: brambur
brambur-5ce7bb9d6a15.text: Every step down is a step further from my mum.

brambur-8600befe1d04.speaker: brambur
brambur-8600befe1d04.text: Everyone hydrate. And pray. Mostly hydrate.

brambur-a611db7016ea.speaker: brambur
brambur-a611db7016ea.text: I KNEW the floor was suspicious!

brambur-7c5dd6b44fd3.speaker: brambur
brambur-7c5dd6b44fd3.text: Sorry, floor. I didn't mean to step on you.

brambur-fc28bd17a653.speaker: brambur
brambur-fc28bd17a653.text: We did it! I think. Is everyone attached?

brambur-93b36945398c.speaker: brambur
brambur-93b36945398c.text: Thank the gods. And thank you, monsters, for being good sports.

brambur-7d35e605e82c.speaker: brambur
brambur-7d35e605e82c.text: I feel... holier? Is that allowed?

brambur-6e5b08025fbd.speaker: brambur
brambur-6e5b08025fbd.text: A secret door! I hope it doesn't mind being found.

brambur-2256cd62702e.speaker: brambur
brambur-2256cd62702e.text: Lovely. Lovely, lovely place. I hate it. Sorry.

brambur-458c2084ee23.speaker: brambur
brambur-458c2084ee23.text: I'll just say a small prayer for whoever lived here. And for us.

fizzwick-86bfce68bf67.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-86bfce68bf67.text: Fizzwick steps forward, magnificent and unafraid.

fizzwick-ec66ed9454b4.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-ec66ed9454b4.text: Behold! Fizzwick prepares an academically rigorous beating.

fizzwick-d4e5c85bc320.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-d4e5c85bc320.text: Fizzwick notes the enemy's poor posture. Advantage: Fizzwick.

fizzwick-27123c7a93bc.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-27123c7a93bc.text: Another triumph for Fizzwick. He will mention it in his memoirs. Chapter nine.

fizzwick-c43f9f461f48.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-c43f9f461f48.text: Fizzwick did that. Write it down.

fizzwick-3e7f6d48b65a.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-3e7f6d48b65a.text: A flawless execution, as Fizzwick predicted in his 1374 treatise.

fizzwick-9456e385abac.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-9456e385abac.text: Fizzwick... will allow it. This once.

fizzwick-56ce489e3c65.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-56ce489e3c65.text: Fizzwick's dignity has been bruised. Also his spleen.

fizzwick-143717ccf7c0.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-143717ccf7c0.text: Fizzwick is merely resting his vital signs.

fizzwick-6bf610452550.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-6bf610452550.text: Fizzwick would like it noted he is VERY close to dying.

fizzwick-b8128e98a94a.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-b8128e98a94a.text: Treasure! Fizzwick always knew he deserved this.

fizzwick-e779cab25414.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-e779cab25414.text: Fizzwick descends, as all great minds eventually must.

fizzwick-53270e80e282.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-53270e80e282.text: Down we go! Fizzwick will lead. From the back. For tactical reasons.

fizzwick-811aba340702.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-811aba340702.text: Fizzwick will now study his spellbook, which is mostly about Fizzwick.

fizzwick-e50503653c33.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-e50503653c33.text: Fizzwick requires eight hours of beauty sleep. Ten for the beard.

fizzwick-fb5115760300.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-fb5115760300.text: Fizzwick saw that coming. He simply chose not to mention it.

fizzwick-deb9c2cb955b.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-deb9c2cb955b.text: As Fizzwick foretold. Applause may begin.

fizzwick-1abdaf06db7e.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-1abdaf06db7e.text: Fizzwick accepts your gratitude in the form of gold.

fizzwick-c4ec557e8673.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-c4ec557e8673.text: Fizzwick ascends to new heights of Fizzwickery!

fizzwick-937d1a95a172.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-937d1a95a172.text: Fizzwick's keen intellect reveals a hidden door! (Others may have helped.)

fizzwick-2114a74b68a3.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-2114a74b68a3.text: Fizzwick has catalogued this room. It is unworthy of Fizzwick.

fizzwick-3767c4b4a51d.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-3767c4b4a51d.text: Note the architecture. Note also Fizzwick, noting it.

pip-751fd4f52e17.speaker: pip
pip-751fd4f52e17.text: Does it have spoons? Ask it if it has spoons.

pip-d5b9b9220bf3.speaker: pip
pip-d5b9b9220bf3.text: Right, stabbing time. Then spoon time.

pip-6600baca62e4.speaker: pip
pip-6600baca62e4.text: If anyone sees a spoon during this, call it out.

pip-f4bda174b9bc.speaker: pip
pip-f4bda174b9bc.text: Dibs on its spoons. It didn't have spoons? Tragic.

pip-ec550d279a26.speaker: pip
pip-ec550d279a26.text: Oi! I bruise like a ripe pear!

pip-30bcb43272e4.speaker: pip
pip-30bcb43272e4.text: Not the hands! These hands hold spoons!

pip-d3f96fe9cee0.speaker: pip
pip-d3f96fe9cee0.text: If I die, bury me with my spoons. ALL of them.

pip-523856f3c9e3.speaker: pip
pip-523856f3c9e3.text: Ooh, shiny. Not a spoon, but shiny.

pip-0a6ee6936e43.speaker: pip
pip-0a6ee6936e43.text: Gold? Fine. Spoons would've been better.

pip-13f25e931fad.speaker: pip
pip-13f25e931fad.text: A SPOON! A beautiful, perfect spoon! Nobody touch it!

pip-e9e0488d4ff7.speaker: pip
pip-e9e0488d4ff7.text: This is the best day of my life. Again!

pip-da5d5e1711ad.speaker: pip
pip-da5d5e1711ad.text: Look at the curve on this one. Exquisite.

pip-a268094e6b50.speaker: pip
pip-a268094e6b50.text: Deeper means older spoons. Let's GO.

pip-5f3f844d5212.speaker: pip
pip-5f3f844d5212.text: Stairs! I bet the boss has a silverware drawer.

pip-41fab57f0ba3.speaker: pip
pip-41fab57f0ba3.text: Goodnight, spoons. Goodnight, everyone else, I suppose.

pip-ca87d8dec3fc.speaker: pip
pip-ca87d8dec3fc.text: Who puts a trap HERE? Amateurs.

pip-205526cde904.speaker: pip
pip-205526cde904.text: Ow. That's coming out of someone's cutlery budget.

pip-3dee054b9f3d.speaker: pip
pip-3dee054b9f3d.text: Excellent! Now, the important part, looting.

pip-73e4b9fdc355.speaker: pip
pip-73e4b9fdc355.text: Faster fingers, more spoons. Simple maths.

pip-548a342d9137.speaker: pip
pip-548a342d9137.text: A secret door! Secret doors always lead to secret spoons.

pip-1b96894cd824.speaker: pip
pip-1b96894cd824.text: Ooh, new room! Anyone see any spoons?

pip-e2dbe776805a.speaker: pip
pip-e2dbe776805a.text: I'll check the corners. Corners are where the good stuff hides.

grumsh-d7efd86fbfa2.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-d7efd86fbfa2.text: Let us dance, friend. A slow, sad dance.

grumsh-ea2455c8b4dc.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-ea2455c8b4dc.text: A perfect blow. It brings me no joy. Well, a little joy.

grumsh-51c6bc95663d.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-51c6bc95663d.text: Yes. Hurt me. It is good for the art.

grumsh-1160b5cbcf96.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-1160b5cbcf96.text: I see the light. It is grey. Of course it is grey.

grumsh-eb8a8fe25f5f.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-eb8a8fe25f5f.text: Tell my lute… I was sorry about the third string.

grumsh-b73144cc743d.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-b73144cc743d.text: Gold. It cannot buy back the past. It can buy soup, though.

grumsh-c9f390db71f6.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-c9f390db71f6.text: Treasure. How hollow. I will take it.

grumsh-41a84d206a64.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-41a84d206a64.text: Down. Always down. The story of my life.

grumsh-feeb9bfc803c.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-feeb9bfc803c.text: Deeper into the gloom. Finally, somewhere that understands me.

grumsh-e42a36d5eab1.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-e42a36d5eab1.text: A trap. Life is a trap. This one is just more literal.

grumsh-e4b1b10f95d7.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-e4b1b10f95d7.text: Ow. The floor, too, has betrayed me.

grumsh-149a8834c1c9.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-149a8834c1c9.text: A hidden door. Like the hidden door in my heart. Which is locked.

grumsh-bcbf99a1edef.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-bcbf99a1edef.text: Another room. Another reminder that all rooms end.

grumsh-bab041cadcff.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-bab041cadcff.text: This place has seen sorrow. I relate.

zizzy-02b1b3ff5157.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-02b1b3ff5157.text: YES! A party! Parties are just explosions with snacks!

zizzy-ebba1eb0cc60.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-ebba1eb0cc60.text: Zizzy reporting for duty! Do we have a budget for property damage?

zizzy-ffe813c8c44a.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-ffe813c8c44a.text: Finally! I was getting so bored of not exploding things.

zizzy-5888add1406c.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-5888add1406c.text: KABOOM! Okay, that one was more of a "fwoomp". Six out of ten.

zizzy-ef9eb6c05426.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-ef9eb6c05426.text: DID YOU SEE THAT?! Ten out of ten! TEN!

zizzy-aaf47d6b67f6.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-aaf47d6b67f6.text: That was SO loud. I love it here.

zizzy-585d0e7dcdcf.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-585d0e7dcdcf.text: Ow! Rude! I am going to explode you SO much.

zizzy-d6ab512dbcb5.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-d6ab512dbcb5.text: Ha! That tickled! …It did not tickle.

zizzy-56ec55cb414f.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-56ec55cb414f.text: I am mostly fine! Partially on fire, but mostly fine!

zizzy-eeb6d26918cd.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-eeb6d26918cd.text: Small problem! I am leaking and also smouldering!

zizzy-5c2222cd00f7.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-5c2222cd00f7.text: Shiny! Does it explode? Can I make it explode?

zizzy-1178573df543.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-1178573df543.text: Gold! Melts at a very satisfying temperature.

zizzy-e479e84e946a.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-e479e84e946a.text: Downstairs! Deeper means stuffier air means BIGGER BOOMS.

zizzy-fd245cf1757e.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-fd245cf1757e.text: I will just practise some tiny, quiet explosions. Very tiny. Mostly.

zizzy-1193179226d3.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-1193179226d3.text: Goodnight! If you hear a bang, that was absolutely not me.

zizzy-039ef2b0a7c1.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-039ef2b0a7c1.text: A trap! I could have made a much better one.

zizzy-8bd686606e28.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-8bd686606e28.text: Ooh, a pressure plate! Can we set it off again?

zizzy-02a37594d9fb.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-02a37594d9fb.text: WE WON! Can we celebrate with fireworks? I brought fireworks.

zizzy-eeeb059acf86.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-eeeb059acf86.text: More power! More BOOM! This is the best day!

zizzy-a39b4114e88b.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-a39b4114e88b.text: A secret door! I was about to blow a hole in the wall, so this is a bit of a let-down.

zizzy-885c266ccf72.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-885c266ccf72.text: New place! Does anything here explode? Can I check?

zizzy-13ed463fccb7.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-13ed463fccb7.text: I love it. It smells like danger and singed eyebrows.

vexrath-bfe873bdbf75.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-bfe873bdbf75.text: Please take a number. You will all be smitten in order.

vexrath-cbd59001d6c3.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-cbd59001d6c3.text: That was a breach of protocol! I will be filing a complaint!

vexrath-d696225d9673.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-d696225d9673.text: Ow. That requires an incident report.

vexrath-d6f6a58efb1f.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-d6f6a58efb1f.text: My vital paperwork is nearly depleted.

vexrath-6aa26f9242ac.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-6aa26f9242ac.text: I may need to file for a leave of absence. Permanently.

vexrath-56f9b4970cef.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-56f9b4970cef.text: I will need a receipt for this treasure.

vexrath-c70e886f2889.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-c70e886f2889.text: Proceeding to the next level, as per the itinerary.

vexrath-a770b0d1fcaa.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-a770b0d1fcaa.text: Descending. I have pre-filled our flight-from-danger forms.

vexrath-991e69594b0f.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-991e69594b0f.text: This trap is NOT up to code.

vexrath-0ab034df37ed.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-0ab034df37ed.text: An unlicensed trap! Someone is getting a fine.

vexrath-2599486ebebb.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-2599486ebebb.text: An unregistered door! I am adding it to the official map.

vexrath-83bc9d6709aa.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-83bc9d6709aa.text: My clan built halls like this. Better ones, mind you.

vexrath-f527e5e20578.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-f527e5e20578.text: Keep your blades ready. Places this quiet are rarely empty.

nettle-6bc6cfaab0d6.speaker: nettle
nettle-6bc6cfaab0d6.text: Have I ever told you about the time I joined a party and saved the world? Well, here we go again.

nettle-ff4f46f15ed1.speaker: nettle
nettle-ff4f46f15ed1.text: Nettle's in! Fun fact: I once robbed a lich. Twice. Same lich.

nettle-db0fc1ba4c51.speaker: nettle
nettle-db0fc1ba4c51.text: This reminds me of the Battle of Nine Badgers. I was all nine badgers.

nettle-2a2764af5dce.speaker: nettle
nettle-2a2764af5dce.text: Easy. I once fought a hundred of these with a spoon.

nettle-41ae7b77191f.speaker: nettle
nettle-41ae7b77191f.text: Watch closely, this is the move I invented. Everyone uses it now.

nettle-304ca949314d.speaker: nettle
nettle-304ca949314d.text: Learned that one from a dragon. It owed me money.

nettle-1e4d1ac25167.speaker: nettle
nettle-1e4d1ac25167.text: See? I TOLD you I was famous for that.

nettle-b93d067894c0.speaker: nettle
nettle-b93d067894c0.text: Ow! That has never happened to me before. Ever. Not once.

nettle-4bfdedc44584.speaker: nettle
nettle-4bfdedc44584.text: Lucky shot! I once dodged a falling castle!

nettle-ab2a6cc55223.speaker: nettle
nettle-ab2a6cc55223.text: This is fine. I once died and got better. Twice.

nettle-c3254fb18a31.speaker: nettle
nettle-c3254fb18a31.text: I have survived worse. Probably. I will invent something worse later.

nettle-89ce0d405028.speaker: nettle
nettle-89ce0d405028.text: This gold is cursed. Better give it to me. I am immune, long story.

nettle-10163851b900.speaker: nettle
nettle-10163851b900.text: Ah, treasure. I once owned a vault bigger than this dungeon.

nettle-b3a82c78d424.speaker: nettle
nettle-b3a82c78d424.text: I built these stairs, you know. In a previous career.

nettle-397d59b3c84c.speaker: nettle
nettle-397d59b3c84c.text: Down we go! I have been here before. Several times. In disguise.

nettle-5da968d1ca9f.speaker: nettle
nettle-5da968d1ca9f.text: Shall I tell you about the time I out-drank a giant? It was a small giant, but still.

nettle-34e52bbfc70c.speaker: nettle
nettle-34e52bbfc70c.text: I will take watch. I once stayed awake for a whole year.

nettle-f15e1a6b1385.speaker: nettle
nettle-f15e1a6b1385.text: I knew that was there. I was testing you.

nettle-dacbb97d4613.speaker: nettle
nettle-dacbb97d4613.text: Classic trap. I invented this trap. That is why it hit me, professional courtesy.

nettle-d76f73b24477.speaker: nettle
nettle-d76f73b24477.text: Easy! Not even my hardest fight this week.

nettle-61019a074aee.speaker: nettle
nettle-61019a074aee.text: Another legendary victory for the songs. I will write them myself.

nettle-9fd4a3517d78.speaker: nettle
nettle-9fd4a3517d78.text: I am even more legendary now. Which I did not think was possible.

nettle-1faf596c76c9.speaker: nettle
nettle-1faf596c76c9.text: A secret door! I hid this here years ago. Welcome to my old hideout.

nettle-cbaec412f403.speaker: nettle
nettle-cbaec412f403.text: Bah, I've seen grander. I once owned a cave twice this size.

nettle-385743fcde2f.speaker: nettle
nettle-385743fcde2f.text: Leave the talking to me if anything in here wants to talk.

pip-9f0890116e84.speaker: pip
pip-9f0890116e84.text: Three is a pattern. Patterns are destiny.

vexrath-ca44fbc58b0f.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-ca44fbc58b0f.text: My clan's honour... restored. I will carry this to the throne myself.

zizzy-1f0ba78dc98e.speaker: zizzy
zizzy-1f0ba78dc98e.text: Oh, we are SO using this on the gate.

brambur-9cac2d97208c.speaker: brambur
brambur-9cac2d97208c.text: Do you think the rats have families? I've been thinking about the rats.

brambur-c4a5fe824edd.speaker: brambur
brambur-c4a5fe824edd.text: My god is Mother Pellwen, patron of second chances. She has a lot of work with me.

brambur-ff9a48af732b.speaker: brambur
brambur-ff9a48af732b.text: I apologized to a door once and it opened. Never been sure if that was a miracle.

brambur-013f1b850f25.speaker: brambur
brambur-013f1b850f25.text: Fizzwick, could you narrate a bit quieter? The walls have ears. Probably literal ones.

brambur-917bc02c7b4a.speaker: brambur
brambur-917bc02c7b4a.text: I've packed eleven extra bandages. And one emotional-support pebble. His name is Gary.

fizzwick-d6b2b2c65b42.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-d6b2b2c65b42.text: Fizzwick once lectured to a hall of three hundred. Two hundred ninety were asleep. Fizzwick counts that as a Sleep spell.

fizzwick-1381312ff44c.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-1381312ff44c.text: Pip, Fizzwick will trade you one spoon for a signed portrait of Fizzwick. No? Your loss.

fizzwick-6d692e7f800a.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-6d692e7f800a.text: The Dawnstone Amulet is said to know everything. Fizzwick merely wishes to confirm it knows about Fizzwick.

fizzwick-59c42eeed973.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-59c42eeed973.text: Brambur, stop apologizing to the campfire. It is a chemical reaction.

fizzwick-f6d7ddab99ec.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-f6d7ddab99ec.text: Fizzwick's spellbook is bound in genuine dragon leather. Fine, lizard. A very confident lizard.

pip-c2993fc08393.speaker: pip
pip-c2993fc08393.text: I've got eighty-three spoons. Eighty-four if you count the spork, which I don't, because I have standards.

pip-ca76cd35b747.speaker: pip
pip-ca76cd35b747.text: A runcible spoon is a fork with a spoon's soul. There's one down here. I can FEEL it.

pip-99bf8beb68ef.speaker: pip

malthrax-2580ca9c893f.speaker: malthrax

narrator-32df22ce7ce0.speaker: narrator
narrator-32df22ce7ce0.text: Gorvax the Tyrant falls! The Blackspire's lights go dark.

narrator-782d7a6d41b4.speaker: narrator
narrator-782d7a6d41b4.text: The Blackspire is dark. Princess Elowen is home, and Emberhollow is free. Arise, Knight of the Dawn.

narrator-e4f9692a547e.speaker: narrator
narrator-e4f9692a547e.text: Somewhere far below, a sixth seal stirs. And Malthrax's staff was never found…

narrator-bb25753296aa.speaker: narrator
narrator-bb25753296aa.text: Torchlight gutters on the stair below. Something vast breathes in the dark, and it says your names. Skarn was only the doorman.

brambur-c3e12ddbb572.speaker: brambur
brambur-c3e12ddbb572.text: I'll have a go. For Mum.

fizzwick-12a0a3e5ba30.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-12a0a3e5ba30.text: Fizzwick calculates the pie at forty percent gravy, sixty percent ambition.

pip-b66a45f0a488.speaker: pip
pip-b66a45f0a488.text: Has anyone counted the spoons? I'm only asking. For a friend. I am the friend.

brambur-b2500ef3b293.speaker: brambur
brambur-b2500ef3b293.text: Right. Pie can wait. Princess can't.

fizzwick-52973ef9dbe9.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-52973ef9dbe9.text: Fizzwick has prepared a list of reasons to be afraid. It is long. Let us go anyway.

pip-03782c806736.speaker: pip
pip-03782c806736.text: He took the PRINCESS. And, I checked, three of Marga's spoons. This is personal now.

elowen-8f0e24829182.speaker: elowen
elowen-8f0e24829182.text: You found every note. Every single one. I kept writing because I knew you would.

brambur-ddb49db4698b.speaker: brambur
brambur-ddb49db4698b.text: Mum's hammer is going over the fireplace. Next to the pie.

fizzwick-1b9189e7b4da.speaker: fizzwick
fizzwick-1b9189e7b4da.text: Fizzwick counterspelled a Dread Sovereign. Fizzwick will be insufferable for a decade.

pip-d8bcf76bfc02.speaker: pip
pip-d8bcf76bfc02.text: Royal. Spoon. Keeper. Say it again. Slower.

grumsh-0a933308a0af.speaker: grumsh
grumsh-0a933308a0af.text: Final verse: "And the Tyrant fell, and the town sang along, and that is the end of Grumsh's song!"

vexrath-efbcf2ca742f.speaker: vexrath
vexrath-efbcf2ca742f.text: My clan returns to Emberhollow with honour. Thanks to you.

nettle-d83cfb52b0f7.speaker: nettle
nettle-d83cfb52b0f7.text: The tale of the cracked staff. I'll be telling it for years. Badly. With improvements.

elowen-a5e1869bb1f6.text: You came. I knew you would.

brambur-19596c9a2062.speaker: brambur

fizzwick-54509481394c.speaker: fizzwick

pip-39d630b57b53.speaker: pip

grumsh-68c229913d65.speaker: grumsh
